international.title: IVF, elective abortion, gender-affirming care and VAD to cease under Catholic ownership of private hospitals
international.summary: ACCC approves Calvary’s takeover of 14 hospitals around Australia, with critics concerned move will add to pressures on public health system Advocates say access to voluntary assisted dying, IVF, elective abortions and gender-affirming care is under threat after the competition watchdog approved the takeover of 14 private hospitals by a Catholic healthcare provider. The Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC) announced on Wednesday it had approved the takeover of the private hospitals by not-for-profit Catholic healthcare operator Calvary from collapsed provider Healthscope.
